notes_list.title: Bischler–Möhlau Indole Synthesis
notes_list.basic_overview: Anilines react with alpha-haloketones under suitable conditions to form substituted indoles.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
The reaction constructs the indole framework through condensation and cyclization processes. It is useful in heterocyclic synthesis and can appear in advanced MSc, GATE and CSIR-NET questions.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
The source describes the transformation as: Anilines react with alpha-haloketones under suitable conditions to form substituted indoles. The mechanism should be read as activation of the stated substrate, formation of the key reactive intermediate, the bond-making/bond-breaking event described by the reaction, and the stated work-up/product-forming step.

1. Activate the stated substrate with the listed reagent/conditions.
2. Generate the key reactive intermediate or electrophile/nucleophile implied by the reaction.
3. Carry out the characteristic bond-forming, bond-breaking or rearrangement step.
4. Complete proton transfer/work-up and verify the characteristic product.
